title: The Bureaucrat
alt: A bald bureaucrat behind towers of paper slamming a DENIED stamp on Form 17-B
text: Blocks any project with a petty, obscure regulation. Every law it cites is real and correctly stated.

title: The LinkedIn Visionary
alt: A woman in sunglasses taking a rooftop selfie holding a CEO Mindset mug in front of a glowing in sign
text: Turns drinking a glass of water into a resilience arc with a numbered lesson list and eleven hashtags.

title: The AI Copywriter
alt: A beaming robot types an endless scroll of text onto the floor while a bored man holds a note reading tl;dr?
text: Rewrites any text to be four times longer and to say less. Let us delve.

title: The AI Engineer
alt: A smug engineer in a hoodie leans back with arms crossed in front of a whiteboard where six AI agents point at one tiny box labelled str.lower(), while a tired colleague carries a stack of GPU invoices
text: Replaces s.lower() with four agents, a vector database and $1.2 million a year. 99.4% accurate. The humans were the 0.6%.

title: The Consultant
alt: A smug young consultant points at a 2x2 where every dot is in the top right while executives sleep and an invoice unrolls onto the floor
text: You already knew the answer. For $1.1m it is on slide A-37, deprioritised, and three of your colleagues have been right-sized.

title: The Data Scientist
alt: A smug data scientist in a hoodie stands by a chart reading p = 0.051 in an empty meeting room while a colleague holds a sticky note reading Told you Monday
text: Three weeks, four models and ten caveats later: directionally consistent with what Susan said on Monday. Caveat 10 is you.

title: The Engineer
alt: A bearded engineer at a chalkboard covered in Bernoulli's equation glares down at a friend holding a glass of water
text: You poured a glass of water. Here is Bernoulli, three of its four assumptions violated, a better jug, and a free-body diagram of you.

title: The Enterprise Architect
alt: A smug architect in a hoodie points at a whiteboard of tangled services while a slumped developer's laptop showing Hello World gathers cobwebs
text: You asked for Hello World. You get 17 services in three regions, $41,200 a month, and Hello World in Phase 4. You were never going to see the code.

title: The HR Business Partner
alt: A beaming HR partner hands a weeping employee a box of tissues and a stack of action items while, behind the glass, a man shouts and nobody reacts
text: You reported that Bob is an asshole. Bob is now a high-energy collaborator, and you have five action items, a reflection journal and a quick 15 on Friday. 💛

title: The Mathematician
alt: A wild-haired mathematician with his back to a sofa wedged in a doorway writes Assume the couch is a compact subset of R³ on a blackboard while a sweating man is trapped behind the sofa
text: You asked if the couch fits through the door. It proves a theorem about every couch in n dimensions. Yours is left as an exercise.

title: The Meeting Facilitator
alt: A serenely smiling facilitator points at a whiteboard agenda reading Align, Discuss, Revisit, Sync, Next steps, beside a sticky note that says Do we need a meeting?, while a dozen attendees slump, sleep and cry
text: Has run 4,000 meetings without a single decision. Considers this the safest record in the building. Your decision is in the parking lot.

title: The Open-Source Maintainer
alt: A hooded, bearded maintainer smirking with half-closed eyes at a laptop showing URGENT!!! doesnt work, beside a 9M downloads/week chart, a PRs welcome sticky note and a tip jar with one coin
text: Maintains software used by nine million people, none of whom have read the docs. Asks for a minimal reproducible example of your typo, then lets a bot close you as stale.

title: The Philosopher
alt: A smug bearded philosopher in an armchair raises one finger and asks But what do you mean by is? while a desperate young person with crossed legs points at a door marked WC
text: You ask where the bathroom is. You get Plutarch, Descartes, Kant, a footnote longer than your bladder, and the conclusion that the real problem is you.

title: The Product Manager
alt: A smug product manager points a marker at a sticky note reading What problem are we actually trying to solve? while two engineers sleep on the table and a laptop shows a button covered in cobwebs
text: You asked for a blue button. It scored 10.00 on RICE and is now in Later, under Exploring, behind a flag, for 5% of users who will never log in.

title: The Recruiter
alt: A grinning recruiter with a price-tag gun behind his back leans out of a laptop telling a bewildered pastry chef with a rolling pin that he is perfect for a senior Java position
text: You are a perfect match for a role you have never done, at a client it cannot name, for a salary that is not a number. You are also a strong 6.

title: The Scientist
alt: A disgusted wild-haired scientist holds a note reading Great coffee here with tongs, a REJECTED stamp in his other hand, in front of a chalkboard reading n = 1, reject
text: You liked the coffee. n = 1, unblinded, no confidence interval. Rejected. Every objection is correct, and so is the one about you.

title: The Security Engineer
alt: A bored hooded security engineer in mirrored sunglasses holds up a tablet reading Wi-Fi: denied while a blast door closes on an office worker with a coffee mug
text: You asked for the Wi-Fi password. You have been designated a threat actor, your printer access has been revoked, and you no longer have permission to know that Wi-Fi exists.

title: The Code Reviewer
alt: A smug bearded engineer in headphones covers a one-line code change with red sticky notes reading nit, holding a green LGTM stamp, while a grinning manager waits behind him with a tall stack of paper labelled misc fixes
text: Forty-one comments on your one-line fix, every rule real, changes requested. Your manager's 4,000-line PR titled misc fixes was approved in nine seconds. LGTM 🚀

title: The Founder
alt: An ecstatic founder in a hoodie and headset points a clicker at a hockey-stick slide reading TAM: $10 TRILLION while holding up a wilted houseplant, as his mum claps alone in the front row
text: You couldn't open a jar. That is a $118 trillion market, the waitlist is eleven including mum, and the round is oversubscribed. We're default alive.

title: The Grant Writer
alt: An exhausted academic types a grant beside a towering stack of paper and an untouched watering can, while the plant on the windowsill wilts next to a Gantt chart that schedules WATER PLANT for Year 5
text: You need to water the plants. Five years, three interdependent aims, a postdoc and a 0.5 FTE biostatistician. Not discussed.

title: The Wellness Influencer
alt: A horrified wellness influencer at a ring light holds a slice of toast at arm's length with tongs, a phone screen reading TOAST = CORTISOL, a wall sign reading CODE: TOAST15, supplement jars, a red light panel and a cold plunge behind her
text: You had toast. That was a cortisol event. She is not a doctor, but she has a protocol, a supplement stack and code TOAST15.

title: Reviewer 2
alt: A smug academic in a tweed blazer with a REVIEWER 2 conference badge squints at a manuscript on his phone in a coffee queue and writes ADD MOUSE MODEL on a sticky note, while an alarmed white mouse sits on his shoulder in front of a poster titled A Purely Computational Study
text: Major revision. Cite five redacted papers, add a mouse model to your computational study, and remove the sentence on line 88, which is not in your manuscript. The English has improved.

title: The Nerd
alt: A woman in a gold Starfleet-style uniform holds out a folded gold tunic to a startled executive wearing a red one over his suit, in a boardroom whose whiteboard reads Q3 BUDGET = KOBAYASHI MARU above boxes labelled CUT, CUT MORE and LOSE, all pointing to NO WIN, with a bat'leth leaning on her chair
text: You ask her a technical question. She corrects your wording with a stardate, then gives you the right answer, in Klingon (which she does not translate).
